market: Atlanta metro / Greater Atlanta, Georgia, USA
dataset_rule: Clinic-first public-price audit. For every included clinic/location, procedures[] contains every numeric-priced treatment/service captured from the reviewed public pages, not only Botox, fillers, rhinoplasty, breast augmentation, hair transplant or peels.

trust_policy.official_public_price_page: Highest trust among included price rows; direct public clinic/practice page.
trust_policy.official_context_price: Clinic's own public educational/planning range rather than a personalized quote.
trust_policy.public_pricing_directory: Third-party public pricing directory; display below official prices or mark as externally sourced.
trust_policy.patient_reported: Patient-reported public pricing; historical/lower trust and should not be the default card price.

limitations: Best-effort public-web snapshot; booking-only, private-quote, login-only, unindexed or phone-only prices may be absent.
Rows without a numeric public price are omitted rather than estimated.
Starting, range, package, member, per-unit, per-syringe and per-graft semantics are preserved.
Some hair-transplant and surgical rows come from public directories; source_type marks them separately so the app can rank trust appropriately.
Where a practice publishes one price menu for multiple Atlanta-area branches, the same practice-wide pricing is attached to each real clinic location with an explicit note.
Historical specials and public promotional prices should be revalidated before being displayed as a current default.

The injectables expansion includes several TrustAnalytica public-directory price ranges; these are explicitly marked source_type=public_pricing_directory and should rank below official clinic-site prices.
Directory ranges represent publicly listed service pricing and may not match the clinic's current direct quote.
